2609.16760.title: Turn-level Multiscale Density Ratio Estimation for LLM Agents
2609.16760.paper_summary: With the rapid development of Large language model (LLM), agent systems enhanced by LLMs show huge potential in being able to deal with complex tasks, especially involving multi-step thinking or interaction with tools. For applying LLM techniques with a well-designed agent paradigm, post-training of LLM in multiple agent scenarios is necessary to achieve better performance. Among the variable post-training techniques, alignment methods such as PPO, DPO, DIL, and GRPO become popular because many papers show a significant positive impact on the model's performance by punishing negative samples while keeping acceptable training complexity. However, most alignment methods address simple single-turn tasks, and there remains room for improvement for complex multi-turn tasks. We propose Turn-level Multiscale Density Ratio Estimation (tlm-DRE), which assigns different weights on corresponding turns and proposes asymmetric token-level training based on the positive-negative space gaps across multiple turns of tasks. The results of the experiment on a wide range of agent benchmarks show that the proposed method performs competitively compared to traditional alignment methods. The proposed training method enables LLMs to perform robustly in multi-turn reasoning tasks with both in-domain and out-of-domain conditions.
2609.16760.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLM）的快速發展，增強型代理系統顯示出在處理複雜任務方面的巨大潛力，尤其是涉及多步思考或與工具互動的情況。為了在設計良好的代理範式中應用LLM技術，對LLM在多代理場景中的後訓練是必要的，以實現更好的性能。在各種後訓練技術中，對齊方法如PPO、DPO、DIL和GRPO變得流行，因為許多論文顯示通過懲罰負樣本同時保持可接受的訓練複雜性，對模型性能有顯著的正面影響。然而，大多數對齊方法僅針對簡單的單回合任務，對於複雜的多回合任務仍然有改進的空間。我們提出了回合級多尺度密度比估計（tlm-DRE），該方法對相應的回合賦予不同的權重，並基於多回合任務中的正負空間差距提出不對稱的標記級訓練。在一系列代理基準上的實驗結果顯示，所提出的方法與傳統對齊方法相比，表現具有競爭力。所提出的訓練方法使LLM能夠在多回合推理任務中，在域內和域外條件下都能穩健地表現。
